load_experiments: load and cluster RL experiment data from log directories by sweep parameters
plot_training_curves: plot training curves for RL experiments using holoviews with rolling window smoothing
get_hiplot_data: generate HiPlot data from experiment metrics to compute average rank across experiments
display_hiplot: display HiPlot interactive visualizations for hyperparameter sweep analysis with column splitting
load_logs: load run logs from TSV files and compute mean and std statistics per step
